dnl Compatibility shim for libtool >= 2.4.7, which no longer ships the
 dnl LT_SYS_SYMBOL_USCORE macro used by configure.ac for the underscore probe.
m4_ifndef([LT_SYS_SYMBOL_USCORE],
[AC_DEFUN([LT_SYS_SYMBOL_USCORE],
[AC_CACHE_CHECK([whether symbols need an underscore prefix],
 [libffi_cv_sys_symbol_underscore],
 [libffi_cv_sys_symbol_underscore=no
  AC_COMPILE_IFELSE([AC_LANG_PROGRAM([[extern int libffi_underscore_probe (void);]],
                                     [[return libffi_underscore_probe ();]])],
   [if ${NM:-nm} -g conftest.$ac_objext 2>/dev/null | $EGREP ' U _libffi_underscore_probe$' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
